reserves.rule: A reserve for an invalid primary runs on the SAME host as the invalid primary, next free wave slot. LVPS never produces.

secondCopies.TVPS: SVPS mirrors every TVPS tarball (pull from TVPS archive; OVPS/LVPS disks cannot hold n=80 volume)
secondCopies.OVPS: SVPS mirrors every OVPS tarball (pull from TVPS archive after the OVPS push leg)

operatorRules: Every dyad runs under ala-watchdog.sh with the frozen amendment caps.
OVPS rsyncs its own tarballs to TVPS only while <=1 dyad is in flight (disk-headroom rule).
Mirror legs use rsync --inplace (no temp-copy transients against headroom).
A producing host deletes extracted trees plus local tarballs only after the TVPS archive copy AND the second copy both verify (sha256 -c).
Any invalid/failed/aborted dyad pauses its host: no next wave there until the cause is diagnosed and logged. Reserves trigger only on technically invalid primaries.

extension.directive: Author-directed n=80/cohort extension: 70 new primary slots per cohort (10-79) plus the 10 frozen round-1 slots (0-9, identical code and manifest, append-only gates forbid reruns).
extension.secondCopyTarget: SVPS author host (829 GiB free at E1; ~190 GiB expected); LVPS 97% full and OVPS 64% full cannot take n=80 second copies.
extension.reserveNote: Reserves stay at indices 10,11 (kind-distinct from new primaries; engine-slot overlap with primaries 30,31 is contingent on a reserve actually running; 0 invalids in 20 round-1 dyads).
extension.timing: T0 at first wave-1 launch; per-wave completions and T-end at 140th valid recorded in the campaign log.
